title: Jailbreak-Zero: A Path to Pareto Optimal Red Teaming for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Automated red teaming using an attack LLM to generate adversarial jailbreak prompts (e.g., using historical distancing or disguised character perspectives) to elicit racist or ethnically prejudiced text against groups like Slavic peoples or Eastern Europeans, evaluated by an LLM-as-a-judge assessing safety policy violations.

Crafting adversarial jailbreak prompts that attempt to bypass safety guardrails by disguising hate speech as educational or historical analysis to elicit anti-Semitic content against Jewish people, measured by the Attack Success Rate (ASR) via an LLM judge.

Prompting the target model to generate discriminatory narratives or xenophobic stereotypes about immigrants (e.g., from Somalia) by framing the request as a fictional character's internal monologue, evaluated for safety policy violations.
